Each sequence is then Prost-encoded and decoded through read_row_ids to build Arc sources with empty deletion vectors and ordinal u32 fragment IDs. Pool generation/codec work happens before timed benchmarks.

The comments list defaults 8192 and 0.00057, but bare proto3 numeric defaults are zero; actual fallback/config initialization requires source evidence.
